description: Returns a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes or is invited to, at its occurrence running now or its next one within a year: its time, call, recurrence and who is invited and how they answered. Changes can take a few seconds to show here. Use scheduled_call.fields to select which fields are returned.

call.fields.description: A comma separated list of Call fields to display.

expansions.description: A comma separated list of fields to expand.

scheduled_call.fields.description: A comma separated list of ScheduledCall fields to display.

user.fields.description: A comma separated list of User fields to display.
